metadata.question: Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Burned Area monthly product (MODIS/061/MCD64A1) over a Thailand bounding box. Compare February 2008 vs August 2008 by burned area. If collection empty, fall back to MODIS/006/MCD64A1. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (burned area product). Use burn_date>0 as burned pixels. 3. Logic: If collections empty -> C1. If valid area=0 -> C2. If reduceRegion returns None/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare burned areas; August>February => A, else B. ```python import ee, math ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions th_geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([97.3, 5.5, 105.9, 20.5], proj=None, geodesic=False) months = { 'Feb2008': ('2008-02-01', '2008-03-01'), 'Aug2008': ('2008-08-01', '2008-09-01'), } primary_ds = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1' fallback_ds = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1' def get_month_stats(start, end, ds_id): col = ee.ImageCollection(ds_id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(th_geom) return col, col.size().getInfo() def burned_area_km2(img): bd = img.select('burn_date') valid_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(bd.mask()) burned_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(bd.gt(0)) valid_m2 = valid_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=th_geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e12 ).get('area') burned_m2 = burned_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=th_geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e12 ).get('area') return valid_m2, burned_m2 try: # 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback used_ds = primary_ds stats = {} empties = {} for label, (s, e) in months.items(): col, sz = get_month_stats(s, e, primary_ds) if sz == 0: col, sz = get_month_stats(s, e, fallback_ds) used_ds = fallback_ds if sz > 0 else used_ds empties[label] = (sz == 0) stats[label] = (col, sz) if any(empties.values()): for label in months: print(f"{label} Images: {stats[label][1]}") print("C1") else: print(f"Dataset: {used_ds}") results = {} for label, (s, e) in months.items(): col = stats[label][0] img = ee.Image(col.first()) valid_m2 = img # placeholder to keep variable names valid_m2, burned_m2 = burned_area_km2(img) valid_m2 = valid_m2.getInfo() burned_m2 = burned_m2.getInfo() if valid_m2 is None or burned_m2 is None or (isinstance(burned_m2, float) and math.isnan(burned_m2)): print(f"{label} Calculation failed.") print("C3") raise SystemExit if valid_m2 == 0: print(f"{label}: No valid pixels in region.") print("C2") raise SystemExit burned_km2 = burned_m2 / 1e6 valid_km2 = valid_m2 / 1e6 burned_pct = 100.0 * burned_m2 / valid_m2 if valid_m2 > 0 else 0.0 results[label] = {'burned_km2': burned_km2, 'valid_km2': valid_km2, 'burned_pct': burned_pct} print(f"{label} Images: {stats[label][1]} | Valid km2: {valid_km2:.0f} | Burned km2: {burned_km2:.1f} | Burned %: {burned_pct:.3f}") aug = results['Aug2008']['burned_km2'] feb = results['Feb2008']['burned_km2'] delta = aug - feb print(f"Aug - Feb burned km2: {delta:.1f}") print("A" if aug > feb else "B") except Exception as e: # Any unexpected dataset/band/syntax/memory issues fall here print("D") ```

import ee, math
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
th_geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([97.3, 5.5, 105.9, 20.5], proj=None, geodesic=False)

months = {
    'Feb2008': ('2008-02-01', '2008-03-01'),
    'Aug2008': ('2008-08-01', '2008-09-01'),
}

primary_ds = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1'
fallback_ds = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1'

def get_month_stats(start, end, ds_id):
    col = ee.ImageCollection(ds_id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(th_geom)
    return col, col.size().getInfo()

def burned_area_km2(img):
    bd = img.select('burn_date')
    valid_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(bd.mask())
    burned_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(bd.gt(0))
    valid_m2 = valid_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=th_geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e12
    ).get('area')
    burned_m2 = burned_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=th_geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e12
    ).get('area')
    return valid_m2, burned_m2

try:
    # 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    used_ds = primary_ds
    stats = {}
    empties = {}
    for label, (s, e) in months.items():
        col, sz = get_month_stats(s, e, primary_ds)
        if sz == 0:
            col, sz = get_month_stats(s, e, fallback_ds)
            used_ds = fallback_ds if sz > 0 else used_ds
        empties[label] = (sz == 0)
        stats[label] = (col, sz)

    if any(empties.values()):
        for label in months:
            print(f"{label} Images: {stats[label][1]}")
        print("C1")
    else:
        print(f"Dataset: {used_ds}")
        results = {}
        for label, (s, e) in months.items():
            col = stats[label][0]
            img = ee.Image(col.first())
            valid_m2 = img  # placeholder to keep variable names
            valid_m2, burned_m2 = burned_area_km2(img)
            valid_m2 = valid_m2.getInfo()
            burned_m2 = burned_m2.getInfo()

            if valid_m2 is None or burned_m2 is None or (isinstance(burned_m2, float) and math.isnan(burned_m2)):
                print(f"{label} Calculation failed.")
                print("C3")
                raise SystemExit

            if valid_m2 == 0:
                print(f"{label}: No valid pixels in region.")
                print("C2")
                raise SystemExit

            burned_km2 = burned_m2 / 1e6
            valid_km2 = valid_m2 / 1e6
            burned_pct = 100.0 * burned_m2 / valid_m2 if valid_m2 > 0 else 0.0
            results[label] = {'burned_km2': burned_km2, 'valid_km2': valid_km2, 'burned_pct': burned_pct}

            print(f"{label} Images: {stats[label][1]} | Valid km2: {valid_km2:.0f} | Burned km2: {burned_km2:.1f} | Burned %: {burned_pct:.3f}")

        aug = results['Aug2008']['burned_km2']
        feb = results['Feb2008']['burned_km2']
        delta = aug - feb
        print(f"Aug - Feb burned km2: {delta:.1f}")
        print("A" if aug > feb else "B")

except Exception as e:
    # Any unexpected dataset/band/syntax/memory issues fall here
    print("D")
